frequency_question: How often do joint fiscal councils successfully implement proposed structural sector-specific tax changes within their target timeframe when administrative will and capability are present?
membership_rule: Includes formal council-level proposals for sector-specific indirect tax adjustments considered by the joint council; excludes deadlocked discussions without consensus intent.

cases.name: 50th GST Council decision on online gaming/casinos
45th GST Council decision on footwear/textile inverted duty correction
48th GST Council clarification on rabri/mawa tax rates
52nd GST Council clarification on corporate guarantees
53rd GST Council recommendation on solar cookers and milk cans

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major structured tax-clarification/rate adjustments enumerated; all successfully resolved by the council once alignment existed.
known_gaps: Does not account for items indefinitely stalled in group-of-ministers committees prior to council placement.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 enumerated relevant major rate/clarification decisions where intent and capability were aligned.
validity_reason: The institutional voting framework and decision-making dynamics of the joint council remain stable across medium-term political cycles.
